page_title: MON 0-0 RBL | B. Monchengladbach v RB Leipzig 28/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+5' Moritz Nicolas leaps like a salmon to deny Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.

90+4' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
90+2' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to RB Leipzig.
90+1' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Ridle Baku is replaced by Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig).
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The substitution has been made. Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) has replaced Franck Honorat.
88' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging some short passes.
86' A pass by Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
83' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) is substituted due to injury. Eugen Polanski gives a chance to Marvin Friedrich.
82' Substitution. Conrad Harder did his best and is replaced by Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig).
81' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Moritz Nicolas easily deals with the threat.
80' A great pass puts David Raum (RB Leipzig) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hit his shot off the crossbar.
79' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

79' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to B. Monchengladbach.
76' The B. Monchengladbach players are stunned as referee Timo Gerach changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
75' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for B. Monchengladbach as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.

74' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Timo Gerach blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
73' Eugen Polanski has decided to make a change. Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Haris Tabakovic.
73' Substitution. Florian Neuhaus will be replaced by Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach).

72' A long pass finds Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for RB Leipzig.

71' A sweet pass finds Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Moritz Nicolas is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. RB Leipzig get a corner.

70' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
70' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for RB Leipzig.
69' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.
69' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
67' A quickly taken corner by RB Leipzig.
66' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Xaver Schlager and he is replaced by Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antonio Nusa leaves the pitch and Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) comes on.

66' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. RB Leipzig force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
63' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Moritz Nicolas.
61' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) for his blatant foul.
59' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

58' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
58' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from RB Leipzig.

57' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
57' It will be a corner kick for B. Monchengladbach.
57' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. They send men into the box.
53' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Timo Gerach didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.
48' The goal by B. Monchengladbach is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
47' The B. Monchengladbach players halt their celebrations as referee Timo Gerach makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
47' Goal! Rocco Reitz tees up Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:0.
47' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
46' The whistle blows and Timo Gerach starts the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
45' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
43' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
43' A cross from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. B. Monchengladbach will take a corner kick.
42' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
40' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
38' 54:46 – the latest ball possession ratio.

36' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
35' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
33' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Peter Gulacsi intercepts the ball.
30' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
28' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
27' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
25' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends the corner into the box, but Peter Gulacsi intercepts it and averts the threat.
23' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Timo Gerach blows his whistle for a foul.
22' That's unlucky! Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
21' RB Leipzig enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
19' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) plays a long ball to Haris Tabakovic, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
17' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
15' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Peter Gulacsi, who smothers the ball.

13' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
11' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
10' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.

9' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Timo Gerach blows his whistle for an infringement. RB Leipzig have a free kick from a promising distance.
7' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
6' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
5' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will take a throw-in.
3' A spell of possession for B. Monchengladbach in an attempt to control the game.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and B. Monchengladbach will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Timo Gerach.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
